title: Maintenance and chemical organizational closure
substrates: Artificial chemistry or endogenous repair mechanisms
question: Does persistence depend causally on resource-funded internal repair?
primary_outcomes: Recovery and constituent turnover after standardized damage; conservation residual
controls: Internal-repair knockout; inert oscillator; externally reset pattern
falsifier: No causal effect of internal repair or resource dependency

title: Heritable lineage with verified new functions
substrates: Digital instruction ecologies and conservation fields
question: Can offspring inherit new functional changes rather than appearance?
primary_outcomes: Parent-to-child functional fidelity, lineage branching and inherited new affordances
controls: Frozen genotype; shuffled parent links; mutation disabled
falsifier: No fidelity beyond neutral environmental resemblance

title: Cross-feeding and niche evolution
question: Do reciprocal exchanges and spatial niches sustain more functional diversification?
primary_outcomes: Independently verified repertoire and ecological interaction network
controls: One-resource matched-energy control; disable byproduct transfer; freeze niche construction

title: Evolutionary stepping stones and open-ended novelty
substrates: Evolving heritable organizations across neutral and complex niches
question: Do new adaptive capabilities keep emerging past fixed-task saturation?
primary_outcomes: New functional trait rate vs generation with lineage confirmation
controls: Neutral fitness; shuffled heredity; external novelty reward off; matched longer horizon
falsifier: Metric novelty without functional effects; persistent plateaus at tested budgets

title: Ecological selection for within-life sensing and learning
substrates: Limited-resource changing environment with latency and cues
question: Do new predictive internal states improve viability without explicit learning reward?
primary_outcomes: Unseen-condition viability, cue use and within-life behavioral plasticity
controls: Cue scrambling; no delayed information; immutable state; same-resource control
falsifier: Survival unchanged by hidden cue utility or any learning component

title: Major transitions in individuality
substrates: Collective communities and symbiosis among descendants
question: Can new higher-level heritable cooperative groups emerge?
primary_outcomes: Stable group reproduction, heritable group benefit and causal member dependence
controls: No cooperation; randomized partner association; no shared resources
falsifier: Temporary clusters without reproducible higher-level inheritance

title: Independent organization identification
question: Can trackers distinguish repair and identity from passive attractors?
primary_outcomes: Process lineage accuracy and false-organism rate on interventions
controls: Oscillator, fluid vortex, inert pattern, engine-protected sprite
falsifier: Classifies attractive static patterns as self-maintaining organisms

title: Visual versus functional novelty selection
substrates: Artificial life discovery with and without external visual scorer
question: Does aesthetic search predict independently measurable adaptive functions?
primary_outcomes: Function novelty on preregistered unseen resource/repair/ecology tests
controls: Random search, no novelty score, neutral phenotype archive
falsifier: Only visual embedding distance rises, no independent new function

title: Distributed causal lineage validation
substrates: Published archival Outlier causality records and independently defined negative examples, future simulation only by separate authorization
question: When does a disconnected set of computational components constitute a causally branching reproducer rather than recurring motion?
primary_outcomes: Rate of correctly identified causally independent sibling offspring and multi-generation paths on blinded held-out negatives and alternate CA rules
controls: Oscillator, glider, glider gun, engine-generated copy, common-environment source, parent and daughter dependence checks
falsifier: Causal method calls unbranching gliders or unrelated parallel patterns reproducing, or no transfer beyond Outlier's selected rule
compute_tier: offline metadata analysis first, simulation requiring separate explicit approval

title: Inherited functional novelty from mutable instruction languages
substrates: Artificial chemistry and self-modifying program interpreters; only paper analysis authorized currently
question: Does an endogenously evolving interpreter produce new viable functional affordances and pass them to descendants beyond what a fixed-language program can reach?
primary_outcomes: Blindly graded novel executable functions with confirmed inherited semantic changes and viable descendants across unseen resource environments
controls: Fixed interpreter and matched instruction budget, externally upgraded interpreter, random semantic scrambles, syntax-only renaming, no inheritance, matched compute and reward
falsifier: New opcodes do not increase independently useful behavior, changes are externally inserted, or traits vanish by second generation
compute_tier: paper methods and instrument design only; simulator budget unapproved

title: Autopoiesis, agency, and adaptation criteria separability
substrates: Conceptual comparison of candidate artificial chemistries, distributed computing systems, and evolutionary CA
question: Can operationally distinct tests for maintenance, active regulation and functional novelty reject fixed attractors and engineered shortcuts without using a global life score?
primary_outcomes: Independent sensitivity/specificity of three scientific criteria under blind controls and matched resource accounting
controls: Inert periodic patterns, engine-run repair, fixed task reward, resource-denial null, cue-shuffled reflex, nonheritable pattern generation
falsifier: Criteria misclassify inert/static patterns as life-like autonomously maintained under independent blinded interventions
compute_tier: definitions and protocol metadata today; future controlled study separately authorized
